change.reason: The v1 30-second quote lifetime repeatedly discarded queue priority while live selected books had roughly 100k-218k displayed shares ahead. Persistent passive making cannot be evaluated by rejoining the back of the queue every 30 seconds.

hypothesis: Persistently joining both complementary best bids may capture the complete-set spread if queue-realistic fills complete often enough that orphan liquidation losses do not consume the locked spread.

mechanism.initial_orders: equal-share post-only BUY quotes at both displayed best bids
mechanism.end_boundary: initial quote expiry is shortened to one minute before the stated market end
mechanism.maker_fill_model: public prints must consume displayed queue plus one venue-minimum order before our shares fill
mechanism.repair: after any fill, cancel both initial quotes; quote only the complementary token without spending the arm's minimum locked edge
mechanism.orphan_exit: walk actual bid depth, worsen VWAP by one current market tick, and charge the configured taker fee
mechanism.merge_accounting: net equal complementary shares at exactly $1; report locked PnL separately from orphan PnL

universe.selection: deterministic near-term liquidity and volume rank; never historical strategy PnL

dispositions.reason: The 30-second initial quote lifetime resets queue priority and cannot test persistent passive making. Its rows remain immutable but are not evidence for v2.

evaluation.null_outcome: The accepted conclusion may be that queue delay and orphan toxicity make the measured edge zero or negative.
